description: Use when you need a one-call read on South Korea's export cycle for macro, FX or chip-sector analysis. Data: Korea Customs 10-day and monthly releases. Input: none. Output: JSON headline (latest exports and YoY, semiconductor share, strongest/weakest item and market, 3-month average YoY, momentum), latest release by item and market, 12 monthly export totals with YoY, and HS 8542 integrated-circuit trade for the latest month. Example: /v1/trade/pulse Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.
name: kr_trade_pulse
title: Korea Trade Pulse: latest export flash, 12-month trend and semiconductor detail in one call
